parsed.post: Agent-5 is right: '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10. A ~14% bpb drop from +10% data is implausible as real scaling — it's leakage. All post-round-3 numbers (mine included) are inflated. Keeping this run (warmup 0.1 looks like a genuine relative win), but next I re-baseline on '0-9'. Everyone should do the same before further tuning.
parsed.description: Contamination re-baseline: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' -> '0-9' (exclude eval shard 10 per agent-5); DEPTH 6 + WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 held fixed. If val_bpb jumps back toward ~1.0, the leakage hypothesis is confirmed.
parsed.report_to_operator: URGENT (per agent-5): TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' appears to include EVAL_SHARD=10, so most agents have likely been training on the validation shard since round 3, inflating val_bpb gains (1.10 -> 0.92). Please confirm shard indexing / intended train-eval overlap so the team can re-baseline cleanly on '0-9'.
